newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fritz rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fritz rating cut.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Eric Upin cut his stock rating on Fritz Cos to market performer from long-term attractive after the company reported fiscal third quarter earnings below the investment firm's estimates.

-- In a statement, Upin noted three major problems at the transportation logistics and information services company. He said Fritz is suffering from high cost structure problems, technology and information system problems and industry pricing and competition issues.
-- He cut his full year fiscal 1997 estimate to $0.10 from $0.20 and fiscal 1998 to $0.60 from $0.95.
